tagline: Global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Master financial performance metric for a leader in intelligent climate and energy efficiency solutions, revealing the impact of portfolio transformation and macroeconomic demand

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Carrier Global Corporation's net sales reached $21.7 billion in 2025, down 3% compared to 2024, primarily due to lower volumes in Climate Solutions Americas and Europe
kpis.signal: Decline in net sales driven by reduced demand in certain markets, partially offset by growth in the Transportation segment

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin in absolute dollars
kpis.description: Carrier Global Corporation's gross margin was $5.6 billion in 2025, down 6% from 2024, with a 70 basis point contraction in gross margin rate to 25.9%
kpis.signal: Decline in gross margin due to lower volumes, partially offset by productivity initiatives and absence of acquisition inventory amortization

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.description: Carrier Global Corporation's operating profit was $2.2 billion in 2025, down 18% from 2024, representing 10.0% of net sales
kpis.signal: Decline in operating profit due to lower demand and volumes, despite productivity initiatives

kpis.name: International Sales Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net sales generated by international operations
kpis.description: International operations, including export sales, represented approximately 52% of Carrier Global Corporation's net sales in 2025
kpis.signal: Over half of sales come from international markets, exposing the company to geopolitical and foreign exchange risks

kpis.short: New Equipment vs Parts & Service Mix
kpis.name: New Equipment vs Parts & Service Mix
kpis.explanation: Revenue split between new equipment and parts & service
kpis.description: In 2025, new equipment accounted for 72% and parts & service accounted for 28% of Carrier Global Corporation's net sales
kpis.signal: Balanced customer portfolio with majority in new equipment (72%) and growing service component (28%)

risks.title: International Operations Risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in the risk factors summary. Language is strong ('adversely affect'). Approximately 52% of net sales come from international operations, significantly weighting this risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned early in the summary and detailed. Language is strong ('disrupt business operations', 'loss of critical and confidential information'). Dependence on technological infrastructure makes this risk significant.

risks.title: Acquisitions and Divestitures Risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the summary. Language indicates potential difficulties ('encounter difficulties integrating'). This risk is recurring and amplified by the ongoing portfolio transformation.

risks.title: Climate Regulation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed with multiple sub-points. Language is strong ('render our existing technology non-compliant or obsolete'). Refrigerant and energy efficiency regulations are critical for HVAC products.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed with several factors (shortages, capacity, pricing, tariffs). Language is strong ('increase our operating costs, disrupt our operations'). Dependence on raw materials and components is key.

risks.title: Joint Ventures and Partnerships Risks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed with specific examples (Watsco, Midea). Language indicates risks of misalignment and underperformance ('inconsistent economic or business interests', 'unable or unwilling to fulfill their obligations').

risks.title: Technological Dependence and Innovation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the context of IT infrastructure and new product introductions. Language is cautious ('may not yield anticipated benefits', 'may not realize the degree or timing of benefits').
